title: Trial queued heads at once, each alone on main, and land each as soon as it passes
description: The real loop's merge writer step starts the oldest queued heads at once, up to run.mergeWriter.parallel, each trialled alone on the current main tip with only its own affected tests. A head whose trial passes lands as soon as it passes — re-merged onto whatever the heads before it left, without a second trial — and a failing head is refused for rework while the heads beside it land uncancelled.

steps.name: concurrent trials land as each passes, re-merged onto the moved tip, with failures isolated
